snippet.title: Super Magro World for Super Nintendo (SMW Romhack)
snippet.description:
Super Magro World for Super Nintendo
Hack of Super Mario World
v1.0 https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/9868/
Author: Green Jerry
Release Date: August 03, 2026

This hack is a remake of Super Magro World, recreated within Super Mario World's engine.

Originally released for PC on December 30, 2003, Super Magro World was developed by the Brazilian studio CyberGamba. Inspired by Super Mario World, the game stars Seu Madruga (Don Ramón from the Mexican television series El Chavo del Ocho) as he journeys through six areas to rescue La Chilindrina from Bowser.
